Each kind of image a document holds, one after another.

A paragraph set as an image cannot be read from the file’s text, because the file holds no text for it, only pixels. Read from those pixels, its words belong where it stands.

Figure 1: text set as an image.

| Fruit | Count | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apples | 3 | 1.20 |
| Pears | 5 | 2.40 |
| Plums | 8 | 0.90 |

Figure 2: a table set as an image.

| Mar | 9 |
